steps: apply log1p to each finite nonnegative hourly PM2.5 value
for each station-local civil day, take the median only when at least 18 of 24 hourly values are finite; otherwise mark the day missing
for each station and calendar month-of-year 1 through 12, subtract the median of eligible daily log1p values in that month across all years
divide station residuals by 1.4826 times their finite median absolute deviation
zero_scale_policy: station is ineligible when the robust scale is nonfinite or at most 1e-12
